fillInstructions.description: Each removed sparkle should be replaced by the local stage backdrop behind it: mostly very dark navy/black with subtle blue-violet glow gradients, varying by cluster position. Left-side sparkles sit over deep blue-black wing/stage haze; right-side sparkles sit over darker purple-violet airglow near the fairy’s right side.
continueEdges: Continue the smooth dark-to-violet gradient flow through each tiny hole with no hard boundary.
Where sparkles cross faint atmospheric glow streaks, extend those soft streak directions continuously across the removed points.
Preserve nearby wing/stage shading transitions so adjacent contour tones blend seamlessly through each sparkle location.
Do not introduce new highlights; maintain surrounding luminance and color falloff only.
